title: Delete a Pixel Event
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete Pixel events. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. `Note`: You cannot delete Pixel events bound to ad groups. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path| /v1.2/pixel/event/delete/| /v1.3/pixel/event/delete/| |Request parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number
`event_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string
`event_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/pixel/event/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162). | |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type
Allowed format: `"application/json"` | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID | |event_id {Required}|string| Event ID. You can get the event ID from the `event_id ` field in the response of the [/pixel/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858697598978) endpoint.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "event_id": "EVENT_ID" }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/pixel/event/delete/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code, see [Appendix-Return code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return message, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|Return data. | |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": {} } (/code); ```
